verdict.rationale: Terraform CLI itself is open-source, self-hostable software that runs locally without requiring HashiCorp's cloud, and evidence confirms open registry, self-authored providers, and CLI-only workflows (state, plan, apply) that don't require any hosted backend; community comments corroborate long-term self-hosted/open-source usage. missing for 10: no explicit evidence pack statement enumerating self-hosting deployment instructions or license details, and no independent audit confirming full feature parity without HCP/Cloud services.
